article.story: LINCOLN, Neb. -- — Pryce Sandfort and Braden Frager scored 20 points each to lead No. 21 Nebraska to a 101-72 win over Southern on Wednesday. Nebraska (7-0) made just three of its first nine 3-point attempts, allowing Southern (1-6), which led for the first 1:16, to stay close for the game’s first seven minutes. Then the Huskers defense clamped down, holding the Jaguars to just three field goals for the remainder of the half. Damon Wilkinson's layup with 13:20 left in the first half started Nebraska’s overwhelming 43-10 run over the final 13 minutes of the half. The Huskers went up by 10 on Sam Orme’s 3-pointer that made the score 25-13 with 10:06 left. Nebraska took a 22-point lead on a 3-pointer from Sandfort with 7:20 left in the half and led 56-28 at intermission. Nebraska held Southern to just 33% shooting in the first half, while hitting 57% of its shots, 48% of its 3-pointers and outrebounding the Jaguars 27-12. Nebraska’s largest lead of the second half was 38 points. Wilkinson finished with 16 points and seven rebounds and Boden Kapke added 13 for the high-scoring Huskers who have scored 90 or more points in four of their seven games. Sean Van Dorn Jr. had 24 points and 10 rebounds; Justin Page had 15 points and Karez Damar had 11 points for Southern. Up next Southern: At No. 14 Vanderbilt on Friday. Nebraska: Hosts Ohio State on Wednesday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
